content: Let $f: \mathbf{R} \rightarrow \mathbf{R}$ be a twice differentiable function such that $f(x+y)=f(x) f(y)$ for all $x, y \in \mathbf{R}$. If $f^{\prime}(0)=4 \mathrm{a}$ and $f$ satisfies $f^{\prime \prime}(x)-3 \mathrm{a} f^{\prime}(x)-f(x)=0, \mathrm{a}>0$, then the area of the region $\mathrm{R}=\{(x, y) \mid 0 \leq y \leq f(a x), 0 \leq x \leq 2\}$ is :
